name: game-maps
description: Overwolf map-app base: an interactive game map with in-game overlay, accounts, onboarding and multi-monitor window handling.

scripts.build:permanent-bonuses: node scripts/build-permanent-bonus-catalog.mjs --source map-sources/extracted/story-goals --recipe map-sources/config/permanent-bonuses.json --stats-catalog map-sources/catalog/gameplay-stats.json --dialog-catalog map-sources/catalog/dialog-checks.json --output map-sources/catalog/permanent-bonuses.json --source-build 24532579
scripts.build:party-members: node scripts/build-party-member-catalog.mjs --recipe map-sources/config/party-members.json --placements map-sources/catalog/wilderness-placements.json --quest-catalog map-sources/catalog/quest-journal.json --story-root map-sources/extracted/story-goals --localization-en map-sources/converted/localization/english/english.xml --localization-tr map-sources/converted/localization/turkish/turkish.xml --output map-sources/catalog/party-members.json --source-build 24532579
scripts.build:level-transforms: node scripts/build-level-transform-catalog.mjs --placements "[\"map-sources/extracted/package-placements\",\"map-sources/converted/wld-placements\",\"map-sources/converted/main-level-placements\",\"map-sources/converted/auxiliary-level-placements\"]" --level-templates map-sources/extracted/level-templates --root-template-catalog map-sources/catalog/root-templates.json --world-map-catalog map-sources/catalog/world-map.json --output map-sources/catalog/level-transforms.json
scripts.build:dialog-intelligence: npm run build:character-options && node scripts/build-dialog-check-catalog.mjs --speaker-groups map-sources/extracted/dialogs/speaker-groups/shared/SpeakerGroups.lsj --speaker-groups map-sources/extracted/dialogs/speaker-groups/shared-dev/SpeakerGroups.lsj --speaker-role-reviews map-sources/config/dialog-speaker-role-reviews.json --resource-bindings map-sources/catalog/dialog-resource-bindings.json --source map-sources/extracted/dialogs/Shared --source map-sources/extracted/dialogs/SharedDev --source map-sources/extracted/dialogs/Gustav --source map-sources/extracted/dialogs/GustavDev --story-source map-sources/extracted/story-goals/Gustav --story-source map-sources/extracted/story-goals/GustavDev --difficulty-classes map-sources/extracted/dialogs/difficulty-classes-shared.lsx --difficulty-classes map-sources/extracted/dialogs/difficulty-classes-shared-dev.lsx --difficulty-classes map-sources/extracted/dialogs/difficulty-classes.lsx --localization-en map-sources/converted/localization/english/english.xml --localization-tr map-sources/converted/localization/turkish/turkish.xml --origin-source map-sources/extracted/dialogs/approval/Shared/Origins.lsx --origin-source map-sources/extracted/dialogs/approval/Gustav/Origins.lsx --origin-source map-sources/extracted/dialogs/approval/GustavDev/Origins.lsx --approval-source map-sources/extracted/dialogs/approval/Shared --approval-source map-sources/extracted/dialogs/approval/Gustav --approval-source map-sources/extracted/dialogs/approval/GustavDev --character-option-catalog map-sources/catalog/character-options.json --output map-sources/catalog/dialog-checks.json --source-build 24532579
